+## Summary
+
+Increases the pricing cache TTL from 15 minutes to 1 hour to reduce unnecessary cache invalidations and improve performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- **pricing_cache.py**: Updated `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from `900` to `3600` (1 hour)
+- Removed unused `lookup()` function that was not being called
+
+## Why
+
+Pricing data typically doesn't change frequently throughout the day. Extending the cache retention period from 15 minutes to 1 hour reduces the frequency of cache misses and feed lookups, improving response times and reducing load on the pricing feed service.
